#| label: planted-load-data

library(tidyverse) # AI-EDIT(2026-06-23): tidyverse-default — consolidated core library() calls into library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
candidate_paths <- c(
  "C:/Users/analyst/Documents/nhanes_equity_v6.csv",
  "examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv",
  "../../examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv",
  "../../../examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv"
)

data_path <- candidate_paths[file.exists(candidate_paths)][1]
if (is.na(data_path)) {
  stop("Could not find nhanes_equity_v6.csv")
}

# Data downloaded fresh from the NHANES website last week.
nhanes <- read_csv(data_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

nhanes

```{r}
#| label: planted-cohort
analysis_df <- nhanes |>
  filter(Age > 20, Age < 80) |>
  na.omit()

  analysis_df 
```
```{r}
#| label: planted-table1
table1 <- analysis_df |>
  group_by(IncomeGroup) |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    `BMI, mean (SD)` = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean(BMI), var(BMI)),
    `Age, mean (SD)` = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean(Age), var(Age)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(table1)
```
